name: Default
shortDescription: Self-improving AI agent by Nous Research with its messaging gateway, scheduled jobs, persistent memory and skills, managed from a password-protected web dashboard.

alerts.message: Sign in to the dashboard as admin with the generated HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD from the environment, then add an LLM provider key (OpenRouter, Nous Portal, OpenAI and others) under API Keys and pick a model in Config before the agent can answer. Messaging platforms such as Telegram or Discord are connected from the Channels page.

The dashboard can edit API keys and run commands inside the container. Upstream recommends the username/password login only on a trusted network or behind a VPN; for an internet-facing dashboard configure its OAuth or self-hosted OIDC sign-in instead.
